# docker_compose_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the volumes of a compose project, like `docker compose volumes`, by the `com.docker.compose.project` label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_volumes" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "volume_names" {
  value = data.docker_compose_volumes.shop.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `volumes_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `names` (List of String) The volume names, sorted.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The project's volumes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))
- `volumes_json` (String) JSON array of the project's Volume objects (GET /volumes, project label filter).
